in_marathi.name: Anula
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant or Dazzling
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anula हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anula is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anu' meaning 'near' and 'rati' meaning 'night'. The name Anula refers to the one who is near or close to the divine night, symbolizing a deep connection with the divine.
